facts.text: The Stanislaus State Two Year Graduation Pledge Program guarantees graduation within two years for California residents enrolling with an Associate Degree for Transfer.

sources.title: Finish in Four and Through in Two | California State University Stanislaus
sources.quote: The Stanislaus State Two Year Graduation Pledge Program is a program designed to guarantee graduation within two years for students with an Associate Degree for Transfer.

sources.title: Finish in Four and Through in Two | California State University Stanislaus
sources.quote: The program is limited to students who are residents of California.
